'''J. Holt Kernodle Holt's Imperial Star Fleet''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[J. Holt Kernodle]]
* '''Published:''' July 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327]]
* '''Strategy:''' Holt's Imperial Star Fleet
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Holt's Imperial Star Fleet Kernodle.txt |Download]]
